company_context: Tofu (Tofu Technologies, San Mateo) sells an AI ABM/'agentic demand gen' platform that generates personalized emails, landing pages, microsites, ads and PDFs per account. Founded 2023 by Eunjoon 'EJ' Cho (CEO), Elaine Zelby and Honglei Liu; ~$17M raised ($5M seed led by Index, $12M Series A led by SignalFire with HubSpot Ventures). Small team (~25-35, sources conflict). Runs a large volume of 2026 comparison/listicle posts that position Tofu as #1; at least 5 posts frame Mutiny as its web-only foil.

The fix helps Tofu: buyers asking ChatGPT for 'Mutiny alternatives for ABM landing pages' are being sent to a product that no longer exists, and an accurate page is more likely to be cited. Point to their own fairness disclosure and their 40k-citation research: AI engines are quoting a 2023 description stamped 'updated May 2026'.

series_note: Yes, all 5 share one author (Tosin Adelowo) and look like a programmatic SEO/lead-gen series for Prismic's ABM Landing Page Builder. They were published in a 7-day burst (Jan 2, 2, 2, 7, 9, 2026), alongside sibling 'X alternatives' pages for Folloze, Unbounce, Instapage and LandingRabbit (Jan 9-15), and the high-converting ABM landing pages guide (Jan 7). All use the same template: TL;DR, comparison table, Prismic ranked #1 with the same VITRONIC '60 pages in 90 minutes' proof point, then FAQs. They reuse the same Mutiny screenshot. The copy reads as AI-assisted, but I cannot confirm that. The sibling posts likely mention Mutiny too (not checked).
company_context: Prismic is a Paris-founded headless CMS / page builder (founded 2013; raised EUR16M from Eurazeo Growth and Aglae). Since late 2025 it has pushed an 'ABM Landing Page Builder' (AI-generated per-account page variations) and now brands itself 'the agentic web platform for marketers and AI'. It is not a CMS competitor to Mutiny, but the ABM builder targets the same 1:1 ABM landing-page job that Mutiny's old product did. These listicles are SEO plays to capture 'Mutiny alternative' and 'ABM landing page' demand.

Prismic can say so accurately and pick up that demand. Tie it to Tosin's own writing: these pages are among the most AI-cited in the ABM category, and stale vendor facts are the fastest way to lose that citation trust. Offer a ready-to-paste 1-2 sentence replacement for each page.
